design_archetype: Performance Pro & Cyber Neon Aurora ('Mega Krass' Redesign)
emotional_tone: Jaw-dropping, aggressive athletic precision, tactical dark cyber elegance, hyper-engaging motion

rules.H1: font-teko uppercase text-4xl sm:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none text-white
rules.H2: font-teko uppercase text-2xl sm:text-4xl tracking-wider leading-tight text-white/95
rules.H3: font-teko uppercase text-xl sm:text-2xl tracking-wider text-[#00E5FF]
rules.Labels: font-chakra text-[10px] sm:text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-white/50

layout_and_bento.spacing_scale: p-3 sm:p-5 md:p-8 gap-3 sm:gap-4 md:gap-6
layout_and_bento.dashboard_grid: Base grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4. Hero spans 12 cols. Stats row spans 12 cols (3 or 4 tiles). Week Schedule spans 12 cols or 8 cols hero side. Plan section 12 cols or 2-col bento.
layout_and_bento.border_rules: All tiles must have direct padding (p-4 or p-5) to avoid content edge collision. Use custom clip-corner-tl-br cut corners and 1px border with rgba(0,191,255,0.18) minimum opacity.

visual_enhancers.aurora_backdrop: Multi-layer radial-gradient with blur-2xl and 22s animation 'aurora-drift' for depth
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: 1px dynamic shimmering border on priority cards with animated linear gradient
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10 for floating badges and modal cards
visual_enhancers.grain_overlay: SVG fractalNoise turbulence background overlay at 8%-12% opacity to break digital flatness
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: glow-text (text-shadow) for primary headings and volt-green PR bursts

DashboardHero.styling: Cinematic aurora container with animated gradient backdrop, time-aware greeting badge, breathing streak flame counter with glow pill, electric glow user headline, daily quote quote box with left cyan border, and a high-impact 'TRAINING FORTSETZEN' CTA button with pulse animation.

QuickStatsRow.styling: 3-column or 4-column Bento grid row featuring: 1. Workouts completed, 2. Total Volume with formatted unit (t / M), 3. Pro Status / Streak, 4. Current Mesocycle Phase. Each tile has a subtle radial glow background and chrome gradient typography.

WeekSchedule.styling: Horizontal mobile scrollable / desktop grid day selector with completed indicator checkmarks, current day cyan aura highlight, and rest day mute states.

PlanSection.styling: Bento plan cards with corner diagonal cuts (clip-corner-tl-br), mesocycle block/week status badge, plateau warning banners, AI Plan adjustment action button with spinner state, and day action buttons.

QuickActionsGrid.styling: 2x2 grid of glassmorphic action tiles (Body Scan, Library, Nutrition, Progress) with neon inner icon glow boxes and hover translate effects.

MuscleGroupsSection.styling: Anatomical front/back SVG heatmap with pulsing animation on the hottest muscle group, intensity color bar legend (Cyan -> Pink -> Volt Green), and weak muscle recommendation pills.

PRCinematicOverlay.styling: Fullscreen modal with high-intensity Volt Green Aurora swirl, central glitch RGB title text, particle canvas confetti explosion, weight lift delta chip, and sound trigger feedback.

instructions_to_main_agent: Verify all components use 'Chakra Petch' for technical body/labels and 'Teko' for all headings and metrics.
Ensure every interactive element (buttons, cards, links, tabs) has a unique data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
Do NOT use pure black background for cards or transparent dropdowns. Use var(--af-surface) or #07070F with explicit border styling.
Maintain mobile-first responsiveness (390px baseline) while taking advantage of grid-cols-12 on desktop for a rich Bento arrangement.
Enhance micro-interactions: add subtle scale, glow, and border transitions to every hoverable element.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Never use plain white cards, default Inter font for headers, or flat uninspired blue buttons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_rules: Always maintain high contrast text over dark surfaces. Body text must be #D2D2DE or brighter.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.micro_animations: Ensure hover states, pulse indicators, and entrance stagger animations exist across the entire dashboard.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing: All key metrics and buttons MUST retain their data-testid attributes for E2E verification.
